args.sql: select p.type, sum(p.price)/100.0 as sales, sum(p.price)/sum(sum(p.price)) over () as share from items i join products p on i.sku=p.sku join orders o on i.order_id=o.id where year(o.ordered_at)=2025 group by 1

args.message: In 2025, beverages brought in $2,612,975.00 of product sales (60.8% of the total) and jaffles brought in $1,683,741.00 (39.2%). These are pre-tax figures: I added up the price of every item sold in orders placed in 2025, by product type. There are no other product types, so the two shares make up the whole total.
